editorial:
Picture yourself deep in the Bolivian Amazon with nothing but a backpack and a dream. That is exactly where this survival thriller drops you. Based on a true story, it follows a young adventurer and his two friends as they follow a mysterious guide into the jungle. What starts as an exciting trip quickly turns into a nightmare when the group gets separated and the jungle starts fighting back. The movie does a great job making you feel the heat, the bugs, and the fear of being lost.

Daniel Radcliffe gives a strong, physical performance that carries the whole film. The pacing keeps you on edge, though some scenes drag a bit in the middle. If you enjoy survival stories and true-life adventures, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Yossi is alone, starving, and barely able to walk after weeks in the jungle. He finally spots a boat on the river and calls out for help. The boat crew rescues him and brings him to safety. We learn his friends Kevin and Marcus made it out earlier, while the guide Karl vanished and was never found. Yossi survives against all odds and is reunited with his friends.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories and true adventures.
